description: This file defines the class 'AttendanceMenuConfigurator' which implements a menu configuration interface for the attendance module within the OrangeHRM system. It configures the menu for the attendance screen, overriding the default module with 'time'.
published:
OrangeHRM rom
amespace or	he ile

classes.name: AttendanceMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the attendance module, overriding the module to 'time' for the current screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the menu configuration to set the current module as 'time' for the given screen, returning null as part of the configuration process.

calls:
OrangeHRM rom
amespace or	he ile::getCurrentModuleAndScreen
